sourceRefs.locator: Brief synthesis and Integrity, property 1389. Liu Bingzhong’s design in 1256; the Palace City, Imperial City, Outer City, seasonal camps, hunting areas, the Tiefan’gan canal and the later summer capital.
Section on artisans, especially the final paragraph on recruitment for construction under Ögödei at Karakorum and under Khubilai at Shangdu and Daidu.

note.de: Liu Bingzhong entwarf eine Residenz für Kubilai. Im späteren Sommerlager des Hofes blieben sowohl feste Mauern als auch Flächen für Zeltlager erkennbar.
note.en: Liu Bingzhong designed a residence for Khubilai. The site of the later summer capital preserves the wall lines and space allotted to encampments.
